author: reek
body: Push-and-shove interactive router for PCB trace layout. The user sketches a path; the router pushes existing tracks and vias out of the way while respecting DRC clearances. If a push would cause a DRC violation elsewhere, the router stops at the last valid position.

author: reek
body: A route segment is a proposed piece of track that the router is considering. Segments accumulate during a routing operation and are committed to the board when the user clicks to anchor.

author: reek
body: An obstacle is any geometry that the router must avoid or push. The router converts all board geometry into a flat list of obstacles for spatial queries.

author: reek
body: Generate a mitered 45-degree route between two points. Returns two segments: one axis-aligned, one diagonal.
